how: Seasonal summer pedal boats for hire on Cockle Bay, with further pedal-boat hire at Lane Cove and Bobbin Head.
Guided four-hour Middle Harbour kayak tour that paddles into mangrove forests at Scotts Creek, Sugarloaf Bay or Bantry Bay when the tide allows; no experience needed.
Cantonese opera classes (a related Chinese opera tradition, not Teochew) run by the Chinese Youth League's opera troupe, open to all ages; price and times on request.
venue: Chinese Youth League of Australia Cantonese Opera Troupe

how: Marine-biologist-guided rockpool rambles on the Nielsen Park foreshore in summer, run by Woollahra Council; bookings required.
Volunteer-led wildlife walks in the Royal Botanic Garden, where a southern colony of the southern earl-white butterfly breeds; not a dedicated butterfly group.
Watchfest, an enthusiast-run watch convention with a CBD boutique watch crawl, held in Sydney with free registration; annual rather than a regular club.
It's More Than Just Sneakers, a periodic sneaker buy-sell-trade event, held at the Albion Hotel in Parramatta in April 2026; Sneakerland has run at Carriageworks.
venue: It's More Than Just Sneakers (Albion Hotel)

how: Guided after-dark Dark Past tour of Cockatoo Island's Dog Leg Tunnel, convict workshops and Biloela House; guided only, no unsupervised exploration.
Beginner tufting classes where participants make a custom rug, with a 4-hour session at a North Strathfield studio and others in the city and Chatswood.
Bar-run whisky masterclasses (Whisky 101, Tour of Scotland, Old and Rare) at Eau-De-Vie, plus Archie Rose classes; tasting classes rather than a membership society.
Beginner origami workshops for adults at Sydney Community College and a private Classbento tutor.
Tabla lessons (Benares gharana) in group and individual format at the Shree Gajanan Cultural Mission, which lists Parramatta and Westmead sites; profile is dated.
